mision.consigna: Summarise a meeting, a work problem or a piece of news from your job, for someone who was not there.
requisitos: the main point in the first two sentences; exactly three supports; one stated omission; your opinion clearly separated from the facts

microtareas.texto: Summarise your working week in exactly 40 words. Count them.
Same week, 15 words. Notice what you had to drop.
Record 90 seconds summarising something that happened at work, conclusion first.

apariciones.subtitulo: Making it easy to say yes

mision.consigna: Negotiate something real: a price, a refund, a delivery date, a shared expense.
requisitos: at least two conditional offers; one question about the other side's needs; one limited refusal with an alternative; one reason introduced with *because* or *otherwise*

microtareas.texto: Write what you want in one line, then what you actually need underneath it. They are rarely the same.
Write three conditional offers that give nothing unless the other side moves first.
Record 90 seconds asking for a refund, starting from the shop's interest rather than yours.

apariciones.subtitulo: Saying it carefully without losing the point

mision.consigna: Review a meal, a restaurant or a dish someone cooked for you — and find something to criticise without being rude.
requisitos: at least six softeners from at least four types; no opinion with three or more stacked; and at least one flat factual statement
to show you know the difference

microtareas.texto: Write five blunt opinions. Soften each one.
Take one criticism and write it three ways: soft, normal, firm. Which would you actually say?
Record 90 seconds describing a meal you didn't enjoy, without being rude once.

apariciones.subtitulo: Keeping your turn while you think

mision.consigna: Have a real conversation of at least ten minutes in English about health, habits or sleep.
requisitos: hold it once while you look for a word
or 250 words reconstructing what you said and what worked.

microtareas.texto: Learn four of these phrases by heart. Say them out loud until they come without thinking.
In any conversation, buy yourself time once instead of rushing.
Record 90 seconds. Stop yourself in the middle on purpose and repair it.

apariciones.subtitulo: Getting it fixed without a fight

mision.consigna: Write a complaint to a landlord, a neighbour or a service about a real problem.
requisitos: the three parts in order; one specific request with a date; at least two softeners; no *always* and no *never*

microtareas.texto: Write one complaint in three sentences: fact, effect, request.
Rewrite the same complaint twice: once softer, once firmer.
Record 90 seconds complaining about something out loud, without getting angry.

apariciones.subtitulo: The tense choice that Spanish speakers get wrong for years

mision.consigna: Describe how your relationship with money has changed over the years, and one specific decision you made.
requisitos: at least six present perfects and six past simples
each one correct for its reason; at least two *since* or *for*; one *when* question

microtareas.texto: Write five sentences about your week — some finished, some still open. Choose the tense out loud before writing.
Take three of your sentences and add a time expression that forces the other tense. Rewrite them.
Record 90 seconds: *What has changed about how you spend money?*

mision.consigna: Describe something that went wrong with a device, an account or a piece of software, and what would have happened differently.
requisitos: at least five third conditionals; at least one with *could have* or *might have*; at least one inversion with *had*; and zero *would have* inside an *if* clause

microtareas.texto: Write five things that went wrong this year. Turn each into a third conditional.
Take three of them and rewrite with *could have* or *might have*. Notice the change in certainty.
Record 90 seconds: *What would you have done differently?*

apariciones.subtitulo: Choosing the passive on purpose, not by accident

mision.consigna: Explain a rule or measure about waste or energy in your area: what it says, when it came in and whether it works.
requisitos: at least six passives in at least four different tenses; at most one with *by*; at least two active sentences

microtareas.texto: Write five active sentences about your street and turn each into a passive. Which ones sound better passive?
Find three passives in any English news headline and say why the doer is missing.
Record 90 seconds explaining how rubbish is collected where you live.

mision.consigna: Report a conversation you had about a hobby: what the other person said, what they asked you and what they suggested.

microtareas.texto: Write five things people said to you today and report each one.
Turn five direct questions into reported ones. Check the word order each time.
Record 90 seconds reporting a conversation from this week.

apariciones.subtitulo: Past tense that isn't about the past

mision.consigna: Write about a relationship you wish were different: with a relative, a friend, someone you lost touch with.
requisitos: at least three *I wish* with the past simple; two with the past perfect; one *I wish … would* about someone else; one *if only*; one *it's time*

microtareas.texto: Write five things you'd like to be different right now. Start each with *I wish*.
Turn three of them into past regrets with the past perfect.
Record 90 seconds: *What do you wish you had done differently?*

apariciones.subtitulo: Saying which past thing happened first

mision.consigna: Tell a news story you followed, but **not in order**: start at the end or the middle, and use the past perfect to fill in what happened earlier.
requisitos: at least two with *by the time* or *already*
at least one in reported speech
at least two places where you deliberately used a plain past simple instead

microtareas.texto: Write three pairs of past events. Join each pair twice: once with *before*, once with *when* plus the past perfect. Compare the meaning.
Take five *I said…* sentences and turn them into reported speech.
Record 90 seconds telling a story that starts at the end.

apariciones.subtitulo: Using them instead of avoiding them

mision.consigna: Tell the story of a trip where something went wrong.
requisitos: at least ten different phrasal verbs; at least three separated by a pronoun; at least two three-part verbs; and no one-word formal alternative where a phrasal verb exists

microtareas.texto: Take five formal verbs you use often and find the phrasal equivalent of each.
Write four sentences with pronoun objects. Put every pronoun in the middle.
Record 90 seconds about a journey. Ban *investigate*, *tolerate*, *postpone*, *discover*.

mision.consigna: Tell the story of a bureaucratic process you had to go through.
requisitos: from at least two registers; and none translated from Spanish

microtareas.texto: Collect three idioms you actually heard or read this week. Just collect them.
Sort eight idioms into informal, neutral and formal.
Record 90 seconds about a form you had to fill in. Three idioms, no more.

apariciones.subtitulo: Joining ideas so the listener can follow

mision.consigna: Explain a course or training you did, why you chose it and whether it was worth it.

microtareas.texto: Write four pairs of sentences with no marker. Then join each pair.
Take a paragraph you wrote and replace every *and* with a more precise marker.
Record 90 seconds about something you learned recently. Use *that said* once.
